seen_animation: A line-drawn submarine with the conning tower left of centre, a rounded bow at the left and a boxy stern with a splayed propeller at the right sits among grey wave strokes under a grey horizon line. In frames 1-4 the hull is tilted, with the left end lower than the right. Over frames 5-10 the whole drawing rises in the frame and the hull levels out, while the horizon line moves up toward the top edge. In frames 11-16 the submarine is level and nearly still near the upper middle of the frame, and the grey wave strokes below it shift slightly from frame to frame.
seen_film: Archival footage of a surfaced submarine moving through a grey, choppy sea, with the conning tower and mast at the left and a long low hull extending to the right. Two crewmen stand on the tower. In frames 1-4 the hull slopes up toward the right. Through frames 5-12 the camera view tilts so the submarine and horizon rise in the frame, and water washes along the hull. In frames 13-16 the hull is level and sits higher in the frame, with swells in the foreground.
named_subject: A submarine on the sea surface (the doodle's submarine, drawn mirrored so the tower sits at the left as in the film).
evidence: e.png 1-6: hull tilted left-end-down and drifting slowly upward, matching f.png 1-6 where the hull slopes up to the right and sits mid-frame. e.png 7-13: the drawing rises and levels as the horizon line climbs, matching the upward shift of boat and horizon in f.png 7-13. e.png 14-26: level hull holding near the top-middle, matching the level hull in f.png 14-26. g.png shows a single smooth upward path (centres 1, 4, 7, 10, 13, 16 ... 25) with no reversals or gaps. No frame shows doubled lines or a redraw.
primary_gap: The submarine rides fully on top of the water with steady, even motion, while in the film the hull sits low and awash, with swells breaking along it and a small rocking motion.
closes_when: The grey wave strokes overlap and cut across the lower edge of the hull at the waterline, and the hull pitches by a few degrees in time with the swells in f.png frames 8-16, instead of holding perfectly level.
protect: The doodle's construction and wobbly single-stroke line (rounded tower with the inner hook line, the boxy stern block, the splayed propeller strokes); the smooth monotonic upward drift and levelling of the hull timed to the film; tower placement at the left matching the film's layout; the sparse grey scenery that stays visually separate from the black character.
identity_gap: The drawing is the doodle mirrored left-to-right with a slightly longer and rounder hull, but its tower, stern box and propeller strokes are the same construction.
